snippets.snippet: Rush Township Cemetery Rules Woodstock Cemetery & Maple Grove Cemetery Cemetery is closed from Dusk till Dawn In an effort to keep a neat appearance, cemetery shall have the right to remove decorations that are damaged, faded, tattered or broken at any time. No trees or shrubs of any kind. No more than 2 decorations per grave allowed except for a period of one week before and 2 week s after Memorial Day. Decorations must be within 12” of monument sides only. No decorations in front or back of monument. Maximum height for shepherd hooks is 30”. Hooks are allowed May 1st to Oct 1st only. Cemetery staff shall have the right to remove offensive memorials and decorations. No glass jars, stakes, stone, edging or glass of any kind.
